notes.title: Tuned Turtle Complete Demo Playthrough
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone

This is the World 1 complete playthrough of our game

Please WISHLIST this game to support us. It's very important that the Algorithm sees us as a popular game !

Tuned Turtle is a wacky 2D platformer inspired by the Tortoise x Hare fable. Tune up your shell with mighty power-ups and cross the finish line before "Loko Rabbit". You are the only hope to save a village in ruins from the hands of the greedy "Dirty Duke".
